features.formula_expression: trunc_toward_zero(net_liquidation_value_nano_usd * minimum_cash_reserve_nlv_ppm / 1000000)

features.formula_expression: max(0, trunc_toward_zero((high_watermark_nano_usd - nlv_nano_usd) * 1000000 / high_watermark_nano_usd))

features.formula_expression: max(0, strategy_bankroll_nano_usd + trunc_toward_zero(realized_profit_nano_usd * realized_profit_reinvestment_ppm / 1000000) - trunc_toward_zero(realized_loss_nano_usd * realized_loss_effect_ppm / 1000000))

features.formula_expression: copy account_snapshot_a.current_gld_delta_exposure_nano_usd after Entry validation

features.formula_expression: closed object of cross_leg_receive_skew_ns, long_ask_size, long_spread_nano_usd, minimum_entry_size=min(long_ask_size,short_bid_size), short_bid_size and short_spread_nano_usd
features.sorting: factored component maps by contract_id; decoded pair component keys lexicographic

features.sorting: factored component maps by contract_id; decoded pair identity is explicit

features.formula_expression: stressed_debit_nano_usd for a net-debit bull call spread including modeled entry costs
features.sorting: factored component maps by contract_id; decoded pair identity is explicit

features.sorting: factored component maps by contract_id; decoded pair identity is explicit

features.formula_expression: long_delta_ppm - short_delta_ppm
features.sorting: factored component maps by contract_id; decoded pair identity is explicit

features.formula_expression: fine Delta of pair short_contract_id
features.sorting: factored component maps by contract_id; decoded pair identity is explicit

features.formula_expression: (long_ask_nano_usd + long_tick_nano_usd * rule_package.entry_stress_long_ticks - short_bid_nano_usd + short_tick_nano_usd * rule_package.entry_stress_short_ticks) * common_multiplier + long_entry_fee_nano_usd_per_contract + short_entry_fee_nano_usd_per_contract
features.sorting: factored component maps by contract_id; decoded pair identity is explicit

features.sorting: factored component maps by contract_id; decoded pair identity is explicit

features.sorting: factored component maps by contract_id; decoded pair identity is explicit

features.sorting: minute_start_utc_ns ascending; exact minute identity wins, never nearest-neighbor

features.formula_expression: ((close_1044_nano_usd - high20_nano_usd) * 1000000) // high20_nano_usd using Python integer floor division
features.sorting: NOT_APPLICABLE

features.formula_expression: max(high_nano_usd of last 20 complete sessions before decision session)
features.sorting: daily_bars.bars by session_ordinal ascending; maximum of final 20 highs; ties do not alter value
features.window: 20 complete XNYS sessions ending at prior session

features.formula_expression: closed booleans: active_at_capture, american_exercise, call_option, currency_usd, identity_bound_to_quote, last_trading_after_capture, positive_multiplier, positive_strike, standard_unadjusted, tick_identity_consistent and underlying_gld
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending; object keys lexicographic

features.formula_expression: count(close_nano_usd > high20_nano_usd for each of 15 confirmation closes)
features.sorting: confirmation vector chronological; equality is not above

features.formula_expression: ordered close_nano_usd values for minute starts 10:30 through 10:44 inclusive
features.sorting: minute_start_utc_ns ascending with exact one-minute increments

features.formula_expression: abs(delta_fine_ppm - 500000)
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending

features.formula_expression: trunc_toward_zero(half_even((underlying_bid_nano_usd + underlying_ask_nano_usd) / 2) * contract.multiplier * delta_fine_ppm / 1000000)
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending

features.formula_expression: top_of_book.ask_nano_usd * contract.multiplier + fee_schedule.long_entry_fee_nano_usd_per_contract
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending

features.formula_expression: closed object composed from spread, ask size, quote age, tick, flags and executability component facts
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending; component keys lexicographic

features.formula_expression: stressed_debit_nano_usd for a fully paid long call, including modeled entry costs
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending

features.formula_expression: (top_of_book.ask_nano_usd + top_of_book.tick_nano_usd * rule_package.entry_stress_long_ticks) * contract.multiplier + fee_schedule.long_entry_fee_nano_usd_per_contract
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending

features.formula_expression: closed facts copied from the bound local result: status, reason_code, model_id, model_sha256, input_sha256, runtime_fingerprint_sha256, numeric_runtime_environment_sha256, core_run_sha256, composite run_sha256, coarse_iv_ppm, fine_iv_ppm, coarse_delta_ppm, fine_delta_ppm, coarse_price_residual_nano_usd and fine_price_residual_nano_usd; run_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical {schema_version=TECHNICAL_MODEL_COMPOSITE_RUN_BINDING_V1, core_run_sha256, numeric_runtime_environment_sha256}; the singleton top-level receipt is canonical {schema_version, c_fenv_rounding_mode, c_fenv_rounding_value}
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending; status reason codes ascending
features.window: single local model evaluation per contract

features.formula_expression: arithmetic mean of deterministic local CRR call Delta from the ordered (model_package.coarse_steps, model_package.coarse_steps+1) tree suite, then half-even integer quantization to ppm; V1 suite is (512,513)
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending

features.formula_expression: arithmetic mean of deterministic local CRR call Delta from the ordered (model_package.fine_steps, model_package.fine_steps+1) tree suite, then half-even integer quantization to ppm; V1 suite is (1024,1025)
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending

features.formula_expression: core input_sha256 of the exact canonical CrrCallInputsV1 bound to the contract, option snapshot, underlying BBO and PIT inputs; this hashes model inputs only and is distinct from MODEL.CONVERGENCE_FACTS_BY_CONTRACT composite run binding, which additionally binds the numeric runtime environment
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending; canonical JSON object keys lexicographic

features.formula_expression: deterministic integer implied-volatility inversion of half-even option BBO midpoint under the frozen local CRR model, interpolated rate curve and expense+distribution+borrow inputs; evaluation is allowed only while the live C fenv mode is FE_TONEAREST at model entry and immediately before and after compute
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending; solver iteration order fixed by model_package
features.window: atomic snapshot and PIT economics at cutoff

features.formula_expression: option_snapshot.capture_utc_ns - option top_of_book.receive_utc_ns
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending
features.window: quote receive time to snapshot capture within [10:45,10:46) America/New_York

features.formula_expression: max(underlying_receive_utc_ns, long_receive_utc_ns, short_receive_utc_ns) - min(underlying_receive_utc_ns, long_receive_utc_ns, short_receive_utc_ns)
features.sorting: shared component maps by contract_id; compatible groups by expiry, multiplier, deliverable_shares, currency and deliverable

features.formula_expression: closed facts: age_within_limit, ask_size_meets_minimum, bid_size_meets_minimum, cross_leg_receive_skew_ns=abs(option_receive-underlying_receive), cross_leg_receive_skew_within_limit, positive_non_crossed_market=(ask>bid>0), and quote_flags copied as sorted list
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending; quote_flags ascending

features.formula_expression: closed object of ask_size, bid_size and minimum_displayed_size=min(ask_size,bid_size) copied from each identity-matched top_of_book
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending; bid before ask in semantic schema

features.formula_expression: ask_nano_usd - bid_nano_usd
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending

features.formula_expression: top_of_book.tick_nano_usd after Entry validator has checked bid/ask grid and equality with contract.tick_nano_usd
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending

features.formula_expression: closed GLD BBO facts: spread=ask-bid, quote_age=capture-receive, bid/ask/minimum size, tick, sorted flags, and executability booleans for age, size and positive non-crossed market
features.sorting: closed object keys canonicalized; quote_flags ascending
features.window: same atomic snapshot evaluated at capture

features.formula_expression: option contract expiry_date - top-level trading_date in civil calendar days
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending
features.window: decision session date to contractual expiry date

features.formula_expression: last_trading_date - H20_date in civil calendar days
features.sorting: map keys by contract_id ascending

features.formula_expression: XNYS civil session date corresponding to TIME.H20_SESSION_ID
features.sorting: NOT_APPLICABLE

features.sorting: future sessions by XNYS session date ascending
features.window: H1 through H20 after decision session

features.formula_expression: close_nano_usd of the last normalized daily_bars.bars item; Entry validation guarantees it is a complete prior XNYS session
features.sorting: daily_bars.bars by session_ordinal ascending
features.window: latest complete XNYS session before decision session

features.formula_expression: sum(close_nano_usd of last 200 complete sessions) // 200
features.sorting: daily_bars.bars by session_ordinal ascending; select final 200 items
features.window: 200 complete XNYS sessions ending at prior session

features.formula_expression: sum(close_nano_usd of last 50 complete sessions) // 50
features.sorting: daily_bars.bars by session_ordinal ascending; select final 50 items
features.window: 50 complete XNYS sessions ending at prior session

features.formula_expression: ((sma50_now - sma50_20_sessions_ago) * 1000000) // (sma50_20_sessions_ago * 20) using Python integer floor division
